decisions.summary: A* withdrawn on its own measurement: alone, on the merged engine, FR-004 out
decisions.why: Round 3's requirement met. astarcmp/results-alone.json, re-summed here: cost-order 220.19 s and 229.08 s, A* 219.67 s (29 rolls a pass, 0 failures each) - 4.97 s under the mean against an 8.89 s same-run spread; 9 unreached over every attempt against 7 and 7, six re-rolls against four and four. The engine is main as merged (fit.py differs from 7c0c94f94 only by a comment; the harness swaps only lattice_search). The GM's willingness to let maps change was conditioned on the change allowing it to be 'significantly faster'; a lever that moves maps and strands more houses for a gain inside the noise does not serve that purpose, so R6's keep-only-beyond-the-spread rule applies. Attributed to A* alone in R6, the spec's bullet, the Decisions row and route.py's docstring. Round 5: every stale passage named in round 4 is corrected; plan.md's B3 row no longer says 'with B1'.

decisions.summary: the coarser lattice withdrawn: 12 px strands houses the 10 px lattice did not, and no coarser cell is faster
decisions.why: Re-derived from b2/results.json in round 3: 10 px 5 unreached / 2 re-rolls, 12 px 8 / 4, rising to 16 at 18 px; and every coarser cell slower per roll over the maps that rolled once at both cells (12 px 1.055x on 27 maps up to 18 px 1.84x), so a coarser grid would defeat the request's purpose. R4 now says it was measured just before main's 269 merged; the monotone trend makes the ruling robust to the merge.

decisions.summary: FR-004 WITHDRAWN on the rules
decisions.why: The GM allowed map changes that 'still correspond to historical norms'; the stepped plot ring and Sawada's seat off the regional wind come from the field and seat stages, which the router (first called in stage_track) does not reach, so FR-004 is shown to break the pool's rules (the GM's own condition), and the pool with the levers was about 0.6% faster. Now attributed to FR-004 alone everywhere, plan.md's B3 row included (round 5: 'its moved maps failed five gate rules, two from stages only it reaches'). Raise it with the GM once the work lands (CLAUDE.md, XVI).
